title: Header length within the serialization
statement: For every machine $M$ in code normal form, twice the number of bits in the binary representation of its state-count parameter, plus $2$, plus its initial state index, plus $1$, is at most the length of its canonical serialization.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a machine in code normal form
replaced:
For every coded machine, the header endpoint --- twice the width of the binary
state count, plus $2$, plus the initial state index, plus $1$ --- is at most
the length of the machine's serialization.
